centroid.parameter_note: segment_min_columns=1 and correction_window=1 isolate the implemented local background-subtracted weighted centroid for narrow H1 ROIs

metric_definitions.detected_frame_fraction: fraction of the 50 frames containing at least one detected column in the trimmed ROI
metric_definitions.detected_event_fraction: detected frame-column events divided by 50 times trimmed ROI width
metric_definitions.valid_column_fraction: fraction of trimmed ROI columns detected in at least 80% of frames
metric_definitions.y_median_px: median of per-column 50-frame medians over valid columns
metric_definitions.sigma_pixel: per-column sample standard deviation over detected frames, summarized over valid columns
metric_definitions.delta_y_median_px: median same-column object center minus method-specific smooth reference center
metric_definitions.center_shift_px: median same-column centroid center minus Steger center over columns valid for both
metric_definitions.background_false_detection_rate: centroid detections in a laser-free background ROI divided by 50 times ROI width

centroid_sigma_pixel_p95_ratio_lte_1_25.scope: all formally comparable ROIs: B12 H1/H10/H30 and B05 H10/H30
